independent_group.note: Nineteen Angular jobs, six package jobs and API documentation. This single chore-branch observation does not establish a representative median or test/coverage parity. The complete workflow was still running when this group was observed.

independent_test_result_comparison.note: Reported source, classname, name and result tuples match with multiplicity; all 50 test endpoints had null pagination tokens. Empty result lists do not establish discovery parity; reported identities do not establish complete discovery or coverage equivalence.

arm64_pilot.note: Fresh builder with no persistent or registry cache; PDF build followed runtime and reused its cache. Builds include image export and loading. Smoke tests did not exercise portal HTTP startup or the application PDF endpoint. Initial buildx removal failed for an unknown reason; a subsequent always-run cleanup step succeeded; publication, peak daemon memory, billed credits and matched parallel-build comparison were not measured. This one chore-branch observation is not representative acceptance performance.

final_workflow.note: The validation gate excludes the Mocha baseline, which completed last overall. The required-check duration exceeded the 720-second target. This chore-branch observation is not representative of acceptance medians or publication performance.

other_image_test_result_comparison.note: Per-job CircleCI test-result multisets of source, classname, name and result match with multiplicity. These pipelines use different revisions. Reported identities do not establish complete discovery, coverage or behavioral equivalence.

matched_mocha_comparison.note: Reported identities, input hashes and image attestations match, but skipped testcase identities are not emitted. Four lines and four branches changed from covered to uncovered in DashboardConfigService and RequestChronicle. Test scheduling and background completion are plausible contributors, not proven causes. Logs are truncated. Source maps, executed generated bytes and discovery completeness remain unverified; neither coverage equivalence nor a causal compilation regression is established.
